how_to_apply: Visit the official website at bhiwani.gov.in to download the application form available from the date of advertisement.
Ensure you meet all eligibility conditions and fill out the application form with accurate details including Contact No., Email ID, and Postal address with PIN CODE.
Attach two passport size photos and self-attested copies of Educational Qualification, Experience Certificate, and Domicile Certificate.
Ensure experience certificates are supported by bank statement showing salary drawn from employer for the period of experience.

Submit the completed application along with all supporting documents by registered post or by hand up to 27/10/2026 at 4:00 PM to the O/o District Ayurvedic Office, Campus Civil Hospital AYUSH Wing Bhiwani.

Candidates having qualification/degree from Distance Education Council or joint committee of DEC, UGC and AICTE/Other statutory body must produce proof of approval of Degree/Diploma from concerned authorities. The Selection Committee has a right to reject any application if found improper or having misleading information. Canvassing or influencing officers related to selection and recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification. Submission of form through speed post/by hand shall only be entertained.

content_sections.heading: District AYUSH Society Bhiwani Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill regional and other criteria as specified by Haryana government norms.

rows.qualification_required: Master Degree in Ayurveda and Qualification of Medical officer given below at Sr. No. 2.
Knowledge of Hindi up to Matric standard. A degree in Ayurvedic System of Medicine (With at least five years regular course) from any University or Institution recognized by the Government.

Up-Waidya from any recognized University/Institutions or Board or faculty of Indian System of Medicines established by law in India and recognized by the Government. Matric or its equivalent. Knowledge of Hindi and English up to Matric standard.
Secondary School with Certificate Course in Ayurvedic Masseurs/ Therapy for six months or more from Government/Private Institutions recognized by the Central/State Government.

Essential: (i) Matriculation from a recognized board. (ii) Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric. (iii) Can read and write in Hindi. Desirable: One year experience or working in a Government/Private Hospital/Health Institution.

content_sections.heading: District AYUSH Society Bhiwani Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection criteria consist of basic qualifications (weightage 30, calculated as 30 x Percentage / 100), post qualification relevant work experience in the same field any State Government/Semi Government/UT/Any Government Board/ Corporation NHM or private hospital/labs (weightage 10, with 02 marks for each completed year up to a maximum of 10 marks), and local area weightage (weightage 10, where 10 marks are awarded to candidates who are bonafide residents of the district and 0 marks for out of the district applicants), leading to a total of 50 marks.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Passport size photographs (two numbers) Self-attested copies of Educational Qualification certificates Experience Certificate Domicile Certificate Bank statement supporting experience duration
